system.description:
Ride is the ability to travel astride a horse or other riding animal, keeping it under control in varying circumstances. Experienced riders can fight from horseback, tend their mounts' common ailments, and evaluate the quality of horses and their tack and gear.

An essential Ability in the Dark Medieval world, where the mounted warrior dominates the field and travel is measured by the strength of one's steed.
system.source: Faith and Fire (Dark Ages Vampire, revised as The Long Night)
